FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.guideText: You can follow the simple steps outlined in the help section to start bidding and instant participation securely.

register.q1: Can I access the site without logging in?
register.a1: Yes, you can browse the website and view auction vehicles without logging in, but you cannot bid on cars or utilize member features, so we recommend registering.
register.q2: Is registration on the site free?
register.a2: Yes, registration is free. If you face any issues, you can contact customer support.
register.q3: How can I register on the site?
register.a3: Click 'My Account' at the top of the page, select 'New Registration', and enter the required details.
register.q4: Are non-citizens or non-residents of Saudi Arabia eligible to participate?
register.a4: Yes. Companies and individuals holding a commercial registration in Saudi Arabia or GCC countries can participate.
register.q5: What is meant by National ID number?
register.a5: It is the 10-digit number located on your National ID card.
register.q6: What is meant by Resident ID (Iqama)?
register.a6: It is the 10-digit number located on your Resident ID card.
register.q7: I registered but didn't receive the SMS verification code?
register.a7: The code is sent within 3 minutes. Please verify your mobile number. If correct, click 'Resend'. If it fails multiple times, contact customer service via live chat/WhatsApp.
register.q8: Can I change my personal details?
register.a8: Yes, you can change your phone number or email by logging in, navigating to Settings, and then Personal Settings.

customers.a1: Website: 24/7. Customer Service: Daily from 9 AM to 5 PM (excluding prayer times in KSA). Auction yard: Sunday to Thursday from 9 AM to 5 PM (excluding prayer times).

packages.q1: Can I increase my bidding limit?
packages.a1: Yes, by subscribing to a higher package level.
packages.q2: Can I pay for packages using a credit card?
packages.q3: What are the available payment methods for packages?
packages.a3: Deposits can be paid via Apple Pay, bank transfer, or Mada card.
packages.q4: What should I do after subscribing to start bidding?
packages.a4: Your subscribed package will appear in your Wallet page, allowing you to start bidding immediately within your allowed limit.
packages.q5: Is Al-Thawri Auctions safe for online payment?
packages.a5: Yes, we partner with major Saudi banks equipped with dedicated anti-fraud systems to secure all transactions.
packages.q6: How can I refund the package amount?
packages.a6: You can request a refund anytime via your account settings. The amount will be transferred to your IBAN within 30 business days after verification.
packages.q7: Is the package deposit fully refundable?
packages.a7: Yes, full refunds are processed as long as you have no outstanding dues in the system.
packages.q9: I paid an amount, how do I request a refund?
packages.a9: If you don't win any auction, go to My Account -> Current Package and click 'Refund Amount'. Fill in the bank details and submit.
packages.q10: Why is my account not allowing me to bid?
packages.a10: Ensure you have an active package subscription. If you do and still cannot bid, email customer support with details of your account.
packages.q11: Can I use the package deposit toward my vehicle invoice?
packages.a11: No, the vehicle invoice must be paid separately. The deposit can be refunded afterwards.

auctions.q1: How do I participate in an auction?
auctions.a1: Complete registration, pay the deposit, and you can start bidding.
auctions.q2: Why might an auction be extended?
auctions.a2: In case of technical issues on the site, Al-Thawri Auctions reserves the right to extend the duration until fixed.
auctions.q3: I made a bid by mistake, can I cancel it?
auctions.a3: No, all bids are binding and cannot be retracted.
auctions.q4: What is the minimum bid increment?
auctions.a4: Minimum bids are specified individually on each vehicle page during the auction.
auctions.a5: It is the remaining countdown timer until the auction ends for that vehicle.
auctions.q6: How do I know if someone outbid me?
auctions.a6: If you are the highest bidder, 'Highest Bidder' will be displayed. You will also receive an email notification if outbid if alerts are enabled.
auctions.q7: How do I bid on listed cars?
auctions.a7: Accept terms and conditions, pay the required deposit, then click bid on your selected vehicle.
auctions.q8: Is it possible to cancel a bid?
auctions.a9: You can visit our physical auction yards specified on the map during working hours to inspect the vehicle prior to bidding.
auctions.q10: How do I know when an auction ends?
auctions.a10: The 'Auction End Date & Time' is clearly shown under each listed vehicle.
auctions.q11: How long does an auction last?
auctions.a11: Durations vary per vehicle; check the active timer on the vehicle card.
auctions.q12: How long do I have to pay after winning an auction?
auctions.a12: Payment must be completed within 72 hours via bank transfer. Failure to pay within this timeframe forfeits your deposit.
auctions.q13: Can I cancel a purchase after winning?
auctions.q14: What is the invoice payment method?
auctions.a14: Invoices are paid via bank transfer.
auctions.q15: How do I pay for a won vehicle?
auctions.q16: Where can I view auctions I won?
auctions.a16: Under 'Won Auctions' in your Account dashboard.

vehicles.a1: Vehicles are sold in their current condition without any guarantees or warranties regarding mileage or condition. Buyers are fully responsible for inspecting the vehicle prior to bidding.
vehicles.q2: Can I use the package deposit towards the vehicle price?
vehicles.a2: No, vehicle payments must be made separately from package deposits.
vehicles.q3: Does Al-Thawri guarantee displayed vehicles or parts?
vehicles.q4: Can I withdraw from a purchase?
vehicles.a4: No, retracting will result in forfeiting the full deposit.
vehicles.q5: Can I register the vehicle under someone else's name?
vehicles.a5: Yes, upon winning, you can request ownership transfer under another person's name with proper authorization.
vehicles.q6: What is the maximum deadline to pay the invoice?
vehicles.q7: Does Al-Thawri handle ownership transfer services?
vehicles.q8: What happens if I fail to pay for a won vehicle?
vehicles.a8: Your package is canceled, deposit forfeited, and legal actions may be taken alongside sale cancellation.
vehicles.q9: How long do I have to pick up the vehicle?
vehicles.a9: Within 5 business days after payment. A late fee of 50 SAR per day applies thereafter.
vehicles.q10: How can I check a vehicle's condition?
vehicles.a10: Visit the designated auction yard shown on the location map during working hours.
vehicles.q11: Can I bid on multiple vehicles?
vehicles.a11: Yes, depending on your package tier (Silver single-deposit limits or up to 50 vehicles for Gold tier).
vehicles.q12: What are the rules for vehicle towing/pickup?
vehicles.a12: 1- Buyer handles towing expenses. 2- International buyers can request export & shipping services for a fee. 3- Papers are handed over after full payment. 4- No vehicle modifications allowed before full transfer.

AboutPage.description: Mootery Auctions (MOOTERY AUCTIONS) is an electronic vehicle auction platform in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with Commercial Registration No. 1134101783 and Tax Number 3022364405100003. Vehicles belong to platform partners and come in all conditions—for example: new vehicles, used vehicles, and damaged vehicles. Anyone can browse the website and vehicles to view all details, and you can buy and bid on any vehicle by creating an electronic account on the platform.

PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro1: We take data protection very seriously in compliance with the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and out of concern for our customers' interests. It is important to us that you understand how we use your personal data.
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro2: This privacy policy details the purposes for which we process your personal data, who we share it with, your rights regarding that data, and everything else we believe is important for you to know.
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro3: You should read this Privacy Policy to ensure you are aware of Mootery Auctions' privacy practices applying within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Your use of any online services on this site constitutes implicit agreement to these terms and conditions.
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro4: The primary purpose for which we process your personal data is to provide you with the services you request from us through www.althawri.com or our application.
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro5: We will need to share some of your personal data with certain external parties, such as insurance companies or banks authorized by official authorities, to complete ownership transfers when purchasing vehicles through auctions.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s1Text: "We" "Al-Thawri Auction": The website www.althawri.com operated by Al-Thawri Mootery Auction.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s2Text: Please note that this privacy policy applies only to this website. This site may contain links to external websites with different privacy practices.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s3Text1: Due to the nature of the internet, Al-Thawri Mootery service does not guarantee that this site or server is free from viruses or harmful components.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s3Text2: We make no representations or warranties regarding the accuracy or performance of third-party software used in connection with the site.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s3Text3: Information on this site is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s3Text4: We are not responsible for the acts or omissions of any other users, advertisers, or third parties related to any event or product sold on the site.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s3Text5: The site is controlled and operated from our offices in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You may use this site for lawful purposes only.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s4Text1: If you choose to make online payments via credit card, you will be required to enter your credit card details online under SSL encryption.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s4Text2: Personal information is encrypted using Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) protocol to ensure secure transmission.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s5Title: 5- How We Use Your Information & Who We Share It With
PrivacyPolicyPage.s5Text1: Your privacy is very important to us. We will use your information to manage your account with us.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s5Text2: We do not disclose your information to anyone outside Al-Thawri Mootery service, except in the following cases:
PrivacyPolicyPage.s5Bullet1: If we have obtained your permission;
PrivacyPolicyPage.s5Bullet2: If required or permitted by law;
PrivacyPolicyPage.s5Bullet4: If we assign rights and obligations under this privacy policy.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s6Text1: Most data we process is collected directly from you when logging in.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s6Text2: We continuously seek to improve our service quality and system efficiency.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Text1: We periodically exchange personal information with authorized entities for service assurance and anti-fraud purposes.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Bullet1: Managing products and services offered, including ownership transfer procedures;
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Bullet2: Reviewing applications and supporting credit-related decisions where appropriate;
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Bullet3: Enabling development of new and innovative products and services.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Text2: Information may be processed by third-party processing partners under our instructions.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Text3: Information will not be disclosed to third parties unless strict confidentiality is maintained.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Bullet4: If necessary for fulfilling product/service agreements;
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Bullet5: If you have consented to such disclosure;
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Bullet6: If required or permitted by law;
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Bullet7: If transferring rights and obligations as specified in policy documents;
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Bullet8: If providing benefits or services directly related to your agreements.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s7Text4: Technology enhancements may result in changes to data presentation. We will notify you of material changes via email or site notices.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s8Text1: We may use information provided by you to inform you about products or services of interest, unless you opt out.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s8Text2: If you prefer not to receive marketing communications, please contact us.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s9Text1: For data protection reasons, we cannot answer account inquiries from family members without proper authorization.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s9Text2: We will not disclose credit/debit card numbers to anyone other than the cardholder.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s10Text: While we take reasonable steps to protect personal data, no system is 100% secure.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s11Text1: Al-Thawri Mootery owns all trademarks, logos, and service marks displayed on this site.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s11Text2: Commercial or unauthorized use of platform assets by unregistered third parties is strictly prohibited under Saudi Arabian law.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s11Text3: Site materials are protected by copyright law and may not be reproduced without prior written consent.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s12Text: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time without prior notice.
PrivacyPolicyPage.s13Text: Any privacy inquiries should be submitted via the contact form on our "Contact Us" page at www.althawri.com.

section1Items: 1. Legal Age: The participant must be at least 18 years old and possess full legal capacity to act in accordance with the regulations in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
2. Data Accuracy: The participant is obligated to provide accurate and complete information during registration and bears full responsibility for updating their personal data if any change occurs.

3. Account Creation: Using the platform requires creating a personal account by registering data, choosing a username and password, and paying the deposit package value to use bidding and purchasing services.
4. Password Recovery: If you forget your password or wish to change it, it can be easily recovered through the dedicated electronic service.

5. Single Account Only: Owning more than one account for the same user is not permitted. Mootery Auctions has the right to freeze or cancel one of the accounts if duplication is discovered, provided all financial transactions linked to the accounts are settled before taking any closure action.
6. Account Responsibility: The user bears full responsibility for all activities carried out using their account and may not share their username or password with anyone else.
7. Reporting Unauthorized Use: The user must notify Mootery Auctions immediately upon suspecting any unauthorized use of their account; delayed reporting is considered an implied waiver of any claim.
8. Disclaimer: Mootery Auctions is not responsible for any direct or indirect losses resulting from the user disclosing their login credentials.

9. Incorrect Data: If the user provides incorrect, misleading, or falsified data intentionally or unintentionally, the platform has the right to suspend or permanently close the account, while remaining obligated to settle any existing financial obligations prior to taking action.

10. User Acknowledgment: The user acknowledges and agrees to the general and specific terms related to each listed item individually, which are considered supplementary and an integral part of the general terms and conditions governing the relationship.
TermsAndConditions.section2Title: Second: Deposit, Fees, and Subscription Packages:
section2Items: 1. Paying Package Value: Upon registration, the participant must pay the specified subscription package value, which is considered a refundable deposit held to guarantee seriousness of participation, and the paid package amount cannot be used as part of any purchase price or other fees payable by the participant.

2. Refunding Package Value: The participant has the right to request a refund of the deposit or subscription package amount without any deduction related to Mootery Auctions through the dedicated electronic service, provided the refund is processed within 30 business days from the request date, with no active bids preventing the refund and no existing financial or contractual obligations.

3. Forfeiting Package Value: If the participant wins an auction and fails to complete the purchase or payment within the specified period of 72 hours, Mootery Auctions has the right to deduct the full package amount and take appropriate regulatory measures.

4. Buyer Withdrawal: If the buyer withdraws before or after the announcement of winning from their submitted bid, Mootery Auctions has the right to confiscate the full package amount and take appropriate regulatory measures.

5. Package Upgrade: The user agrees to the features and details of each available package according to their choice, and may upgrade an active package by paying the difference through the dedicated electronic service.

6. Ownership Transfer Fees: Ownership transfer of the vehicle must be carried out exclusively through "Mootery Auctions". This procedure is mandatory and transfer by other means is not permitted. Ownership transfer fees are collected directly within the purchase invoice at 500 SAR if the vehicle registration is valid, or 600 SAR if expired, with the buyer bearing all government fees for ownership transfer or registration renewal if required, and paying these fees is a prerequisite for completing vehicle delivery.
section3Items: 1. Conducting Inspection: The participant may inspect any vehicle or listed item in its current form and condition prior to bidding and purchasing, and use any tools that enable completing the inspection at its location and during the designated inspection hours for each auction.

2. Inspection Acknowledgment: The participant acknowledges having conducted a complete and thorough inspection of the vehicle or item to be bid on from all aspects (technical, exterior, interior) either personally or through an authorized representative, thereby considering themselves aware of the vehicle's condition with no ignorance if they bid to purchase it, and the sale occurs based on the vehicle's current condition, information, location, and owner.

3. Reviewing Details: The participant acknowledges having reviewed all information, details, and documents related to the auction and vehicle, and that their participation in the auction is based on this review and full knowledge of the vehicle's condition and specifications.

4. Information and Inspection Reports: Mootery Auctions has the right to add inspection reports and advisory information for each item, and it is not mandatory for every vehicle to have a specific report attached. All data, information, and photos provided through Mootery Auctions are advisory for participants and assist the sale process, without replacing the inspection upon which actual buying and selling are based.

5. Non-Attendance for Inspection: The buyer has no right to claim a refund of any purchase payments or cancel the purchase due to not conducting an inspection, even if they do not physically attend during the specified inspection period, as bidding constitutes explicit and final acceptance by the buyer of the item's current condition, waiving any future claims or objections regarding condition or conformity.
section4Items: 1. Bidding Mechanism: Auctions are conducted electronically through approved Mootery platforms via mobile or computer, and the highest recorded price before auction closure is temporarily considered the winning price until owner approval, with initial notifications sent via email, WhatsApp, or SMS. Participants may not withdraw or cancel any bid after it is registered in the system.

2. Owner Approval: After the auction ends and initial notifications reach winners, and in accordance with official regulations, owner approval must be obtained within a maximum of 3 official business days via the electronic system, after which confirmed win notifications are sent via email, WhatsApp, or SMS to complete procedures and payment.

3. Paying Item Value: After win confirmation and owner approval, the winning bidder must complete payment of the amount within no more than 48 hours from notification. In case of delay, Mootery Auctions has the right to cancel the sale and confiscate the full package amount due to non-fulfillment of payment and apply the terms and conditions.

4. Payment Method: Upon win confirmation by the owner/management, the buyer pays the full amount with all details—whether including commission, VAT, or any fees stated during the listing period—via bank transfer to Mootery Auctions' account from their personal account. Transfers from third parties are not considered unless the buyer holds a power of attorney from judicial authorities in Saudi Arabia from the person making the transfer, after which the buyer completes ownership transfer or deregistration as desired.

5. Ownership Transfer: The buyer is obligated to transfer vehicle ownership and all costs within a maximum of 72 hours after paying the purchase amount, otherwise a sales ban will be imposed resulting in additional costs and application of terms and conditions. After ownership transfer or deregistration to the buyer, the buyer must collect the vehicle from the warehouse within a maximum of 3 days from the issuance date of the handover/collection order, otherwise an additional fee of 100 SAR for small vehicles and 500 SAR for large vehicles or trucks will be charged for each day of delay.

6. Exit Insurance: If official ownership transfer is not possible under traffic regulations for any reason, first an insurance policy is issued for each vehicle from an approved company, second a refundable exit insurance deposit of (2,500 SAR) is paid, and third the buyer is added as the actual user for each vehicle requiring it and handed over under their custody until maintenance, inspection, and ownership transfer are completed within a maximum of (30) days from receipt. In case of delay beyond the specified period, a delay penalty of (100 SAR) per additional day from receipt is imposed, alongside escalating to competent authorities to enforce official regulations and apply due fines and insurance deposit terms, engaging legal law firms to follow up and bear related costs. Refund requests for the exit insurance deposit are available only after official ownership transfer is completed by submitting a formal refund request, taking between (10 to 15) business days from submission.

7. Buyer Responsibility: Upon vehicle sale and handover to the buyer by paying exit insurance for repair or any other purpose, the vehicle is considered entirely under the buyer's responsibility, bearing any liability arising on it including all fines and violations recorded on the vehicle while in the buyer's possession, and Mootery Auctions has the right to deduct from the insurance deposit in accordance with official dues if unpaid.

8. Inability to Sell: If a vehicle cannot be sold at auction for any reason, Mootery Auctions has the right to attempt selling it to bidders starting from the highest bidder and then the next in order of bid value by sending a time-limited purchase offer. If the bidder does not accept within the validity period, the offer passes to the next bidder until reaching the minimum set price for selling the vehicle.

9. Auction Rights: Mootery Auctions reserves the right to cancel or re-run an auction without prior notice on any listed items at its absolute discretion, and may postpone an auction if an uncontrollable technical issue occurs on the website or mobile app until resolved. Mootery Auctions is not legally liable for any technical or engineering fault occurring during an auction on the website or app, and users have no right to claim compensation for technical or engineering faults during an auction.

10. Auction Period: A clear period is specified for each listed item during which bidding can be completed. If 3 minutes remain until auction closure and a bid is placed during this period, the auction time is extended by an additional 3 minutes, and so on until bidding stops and the auction closes.

11. Auto-Bidding: Mootery Auctions provides auto-bidding where the user sets a maximum amount they wish to bid and increment units, and the system automatically raises bids on their behalf up to that limit. If bid values tie between more than one user—whether due to entering the same maximum limit in auto-bidding or placing a manual bid equal to that limit—priority is given to the user who activated auto-bidding first, and it is treated as a regular bid with all its details, terms, and requirements.
section5Items: 1. Additional Costs: The buyer bears all fees and additional costs related to ownership transfer, licensing, insurance, or deregistering license plates, as well as any other expenses associated with the purchase process in general.

2. Deficiencies: All vehicles and listed items are sold as-is in their current condition without any warranties and subject to buyer inspection. The participant acknowledges that they will not claim any compensation or demands from the platform regarding the vehicle's condition after purchase, and Mootery Auctions is not responsible for any missing items in the vehicle—including plates, keys, and spare tires—nor is it responsible for any hidden defects or issues that may appear after completion of the sale.

3. Currencies: All auction transactions are bid on in Saudi Riyals, and Mootery Auctions is not responsible for any loss resulting from currency conversion or bank transfer fees between different currencies.

4. Value Added Tax (VAT): Depending on the type of item offered, Mootery Auctions may apply VAT in accordance with regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia at 15% on the final auction price, applying to all related fees as well, and this is clarified to the participant during the auction display.

5. Internet Disconnection: The user acknowledges and agrees that their internet connection is unreliable, not guaranteed, and subject to technical issues, and Mootery Auctions cannot guarantee uninterrupted service during an active auction. The service user agrees to exempt Mootery Auctions from any service interruptions or inability to access or use the bidding service effectively.

6. Refund Error: In the event of any technical error leading to a refund of package amounts to the subscriber, the subscriber is obligated to return the refunded amount to Mootery Auctions, and in case of non-compliance, Mootery Auctions has the right to take necessary legal action against the client and file a legal claim.

7. Limitation of Liability: Mootery Auctions is not a party to the contract between the seller and the buyer, and it is not permitted to implead or sue it, its employees, its managers, or any of its companies for any matter related to the listed item, its specifications, or its ownership, whether formally, materially, or technically.

8. Terms and Conditions: Mootery Auctions reserves the right to amend, change, and update the general and specific terms and conditions of the website or mobile application at any time it deems appropriate, and amendments, changes, and updates become effective and binding on the user automatically upon publication on the website or application without prior notice.

9. Return Policy: The winning bidder acknowledges that they are obligated to pay the full amount due immediately upon conclusion of the auction and is not entitled to a refund of any amounts paid whether partially or in full. All sales are final and non-cancellable, and returning a vehicle after the auction is awarded or after receipt is not permitted, regardless of any technical or mechanical defects that may appear later, while Mootery Auctions disclaims responsibility for the condition of listed vehicles or any obligations related to ownership transfer or future malfunctions, with the buyer bearing full responsibility once the auction is awarded to them.

10. Technical Malfunctions: Mootery Auctions reserves the right to postpone an auction in the event of an unexpected technical malfunction beyond its control on the website or application, and postponement continues until the technical fault is resolved while notifying participants of the issue at the time.

11. Disputes: These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. In the event of any dispute or disagreement related to these terms, it shall be resolved amicably, and if no amicable settlement is reached, the dispute shall be referred to the competent judicial authorities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
section6Items: 1. Data Collection and Usage: The user acknowledges and agrees that Mootery Auctions may collect, process, and use their personal data (including name, contact details, account information, and usage activities) solely for registration, service delivery, and executing auction-related operations in compliance with applicable regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
2. Data Confidentiality: Mootery Auctions commits to taking all necessary technical and administrative measures to protect user data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

3. Data Disclosure: Mootery Auctions may not share, sell, or rent any user data to third parties except where permitted by law, with explicit consent from the user, or in fulfillment of a legal or judicial obligation.

4. User Rights: The user has the right to access their personal data, correct or update it, or request its deletion (unless retention is required by regulations or to fulfill contractual obligations).

5. Data Retention: Mootery Auctions retains user personal data for the duration of the contractual relationship, or for the period required by relevant regulations, after which it is securely deleted or destroyed.

6. Acknowledgments: By using the Mootery Auctions platform, the user acknowledges agreement to the privacy and data protection policy announced and published on the platform, which forms an integral part of these terms and conditions.
